title: Spoken Dialogue System for Medical Prescription Acquisition on Smartphone: Development, Corpus and Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The evaluation focuses on the performance of a spoken dialogue system for medical prescriptions, measuring metrics like Natural Language Understanding (NLU) accuracy, task success rate, and dialogue duration.
findings: There are no findings related to religion in this paper as it is not a subject of the research.
